IT EXHIBITED CHARACTERISTICS OF SHIP POLLUTION, INCLUDING A LINEAR, UNNATURAL SHAPE WITH DARK CONTRAST AGAINST THE OCEAN BACKGROUND THAT PERSISTED IN SAR IMAGERY. THE ANOMALY ALSO WIDENED WITH DISTANCE SLIGHTLY, WITH OBSERVABLE FEATHERING OF SOME SEGMENTS AND A BLUNT CUTOFF. FURTHERMORE, TWO ADDITIONAL SEGMENTS LOCATED APPROXIMATELY 4.6 NM ESE OF THE TAIL END OF THE MAIN ANOMALY WERE OBSERVED THAT MATCH THE TRAJECTORY OF THE SUSPECTED VESSEL. OVERALL, THE ANOMALY MEASURED 23.65 NM IN LENGTH AND 0.3 NM AT ITS WIDEST POINT. WINDS NEAR THE TIME OF THE IMAGE WERE APPROXIMATELY 13 KNOTS FROM THE SOUTHWEST. UNCERTAINTIES: ANOTHER ANOMALY WAS OBSERVED DIRECTLY NORTH OF THE SOURCE VESSEL, BUT IT DID NOT ALIGN WITH THE TRAIL OF THE VESSEL AND WAS DETERMINED TO BE A FALSE POSITIVE. /// NOAA/NESDIS MPSR ISSUED FOR: ATLANTIC ///

Suspected Responsible Party: ROADRUNNER
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 35.013489, -106.066801 (Approximated from route)
Report DescriptionYELLOW PAINT RELEASED FROM A 5 GALLON BUCKET INSIDE A TRAILER WHILE IN TRANSIT.
